name: Ladakh (India)
description: A blue field bearing the State Emblem of India above the words UT LADAKH (INDIA) in yellow, with THE ADMINISTRATION OF lettered in a yellow arc above.
history: India has no officially recognised state or union-territory flags. When a distinctive banner is required, the emblem of the state or union territory is displayed on a plain field; this is that banner, not an official flag.

features.role: State Emblem of India as used by the Administration of Ladakh
